_comment: RANGE-REGIME (ADX) filter calibration. Forces UseRegime=1; enter only when ADX < ADXMax (low-trend / range regime, where mean-reversion works best). ADXPeriod must be >0 or the gate blocks everything. Run only if the screen kept UseRegime ON. go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker EUTR -strategy reversion -interval Hour1 -calibrate data/params/eutr/reversion_cal_regime.json -out ./reports/EUTR_regime -months 31 -train-months 12 -test-months 6 -metric profit_factor -min-trades 20
